'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Singapore]]
**The [[Singaporean government]] approves legislation that will only allow the [[Court of Appeal of Singapore|Court of Appeal]] to grant a last-ditch clemency petition prior to an [[execution]] on consideration or on the basis of new evidence presented by the [[defendant]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/30/singapore-tightens-rules-on-death-penalty-appeals (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Scott Morrison ministerial positions controversy]]
**The [[Australian House of Representatives]] votes 86–50 to [[censure]] former [[Prime Minister of Australia|prime minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] for failing to disclose to the [[Parliament of Australia|parliament]] and the public his secret appointments to a number of [[Cabinet of Australia|ministries]] during [[Morrison government|his premiership]]. Morrison is the first former [[Australia]]n prime minister to be censured. [https://apnews.com/article/health-china-australia-censures-covid-4fce3a556b258cd86bf006707fc5f9e8 (AP)]
